name: launch-as-is
title: Launch as it actually ships
question: What does the protocol look like on day one, with nothing certified?
note: No deploy script issues any adapter certification (script/Deploy.s.sol:303 and script/DeployPlanB.s.sol:1047 only print the runbook), so every call is tier 2 at full notional. This is the launch reality, not a pessimistic case. Run at the derived spot price and at the tokenomics anchor.
